document.standard: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code
document.part: Part A - Ferrous Material Specifications (SA-451 to End)
document.publisher: ASME (The American Society of Mechanical Engineers)

conversion.why_disable_ocr: the PDF carries a complete embedded text layer; OCR would be slower and lossier
conversion.why_inverted_table_config: TableProcessor_min_recon_score=1.1 with contained_block_types=[] rejects pdftext's table reconstruction and keeps the original text blocks. Chosen after measuring both settings over a 175-page sample spread across the volume: 97.32% -> 97.68%, with zero pages more than 2 points worse and seven more than 2 points better.
conversion.coverage_note: The shortfall is running headers/footers (dropped by design) and lettering drawn inside figures. The 34 landscape pages average 85.7% against 97.1% for the 909 upright pages; the weakest single spec is SA-705/SA-705M at 89%.

figures.method: text-subtracted ink segmentation: each page is rendered, every glyph the text layer accounts for is erased, and the surviving ink is grouped into bands; each 'FIG. n' caption is paired with the nearest band on either side, one-to-one, and the crop is whitespace-trimmed and rendered at 300 DPI
figures.rationale: Section II's ASTM figures have no ruled frame, caption placement varies between specs, and most artwork sits inside Form XObjects whose child bounds pdfium reports in form space rather than page space. Neither Section VIII's frame detector nor raw object geometry works, so the artwork is located from pixels instead.
figures.excluded: Publisher and commercial branding: cover and back-cover ASME logos, the ANSI accreditation badge, scan watermarks and QR codes. Only artwork paired with a numbered 'FIG. n' caption is exported, so none are candidates.
